definition: Separated — the husband abroad; the absence that drives the lament. In sandeśa-kāvya, the proṣita is the separated lover whose absence is the vibhāva (determinant) of śṛṅgāra.

sources.claim: proṣitapramadayedam udyate (this, the separated beloved, arises)

translations.note: 'Separated' captures the state; 'abroad' adds the spatial dimension.
